contradiction_resolution: Promote only after narrowing the recorded generality to balanced weakly-normalized fibres with h^0(L)=3, or equivalently fibres of the resulting P^2-bundle. There is no contradiction with FND-0083: that finding says Riemann–Roch alone does not establish reduced support on every geometric fibre, whereas this result uses the additional base-point-free and characteristic-zero Bertini inputs. There is no contradiction with FND-0058 or FND-0104: constancy of h^0(L)=3 over the entire balanced locus remains unresolved and is not a conclusion here. FND-0130 supplies the already-corroborated base-point-free component; the independently substantive addition is the reduced-general-divisor conclusion, so FND-0134 should remain a separate promoted positive lemma rather than be merged into FND-0130. Its recorded kind 'obstruction' is consequently a misclassification. The absence of FND-0134 from proof/findings.jsonl is a corpus-registration discrepancy, not a mathematical contradiction; TASK.json contains the controlling assigned record.

scope.conclusion: L is base-point-free, and a general member of |L|≅P^2 is a reduced degree-six divisor, hence consists of six distinct geometric points. The reduced-support locus in the closed Abel–Jacobi fibre is therefore nonempty and dense.
scope.exact_mathematical_scope: Smooth geometric fibres of a balanced tetragonal Casnati–Ekedahl family satisfying the weak relative-canonical normalization, restricted to the locus where h^0(L)=3. Equivalently, fibres of the relative P^2-bundle where cohomology and base change identify the Abel–Jacobi fibre with |L|.
excluded_claims: This does not prove that h^0(L)=3 on every balanced fibre.
This does not construct a P^2-bundle over the entire balanced locus.
This does not discharge GAP-H0-1 or the every-geometric-fibre issue in FND-0083.
No positive-characteristic version is asserted without a separability or unramifiedness hypothesis.
hypotheses: the CE relations bundle is balanced, F=O(4)⊕O(5)
the weak normalization identifies L with omega_C(-D)
for the relative formulation, p_*L is locally free of rank 3 and commutes with base change
scope.proof_summary: By corroborated dependency FND-0130, a base point would produce a complete g^2_5 and hence a smooth plane-quintic model whose tetragonal pencil is projection from that point; its CE relations splitting is O(3)⊕O(6), not the balanced O(4)⊕O(5), so L is base-point-free. The associated morphism from the smooth curve is nonconstant and separable in characteristic zero. Bertini/generic smoothness then gives a reduced general hyperplane pullback. Since deg(L)=6, that pullback consists of six distinct points.
scope.relative_form: Over any locus on which the Abel–Jacobi incidence is the P^2-bundle P(p_*L), the reduced-support open is fibrewise nonempty and dense.
